questions.q: Two 6.0 Ω resistors are connected in parallel. What is their combined resistance?
questions.why: 1 ÷ R = 1 ÷ 6.0 + 1 ÷ 6.0, so R = 3.0 Ω (less than either resistor).

questions.q: A 2.3 kW kettle is connected to the 230 V mains. Which fuse should be fitted?
questions.why: I = P ÷ V = 2300 ÷ 230 = 10 A; choose the fuse rating just above the normal current.

questions.q: A lamp and a resistor are in series with a 6.0 V battery. The p.d. across the lamp is 2.5 V. What is the p.d. across the resistor?
questions.why: In series the p.d.s add up to the source p.d.: 6.0 − 2.5 = 3.5 V.

questions.q: A 2.0 kW heater is used for 3.0 hours. Electricity costs €0.25 per kW h. Calculate the cost.
points: energy in kW h = kW × h = 6.0 kW h
